tcp:ttl:64.comment: Initial TTL 64 — Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, iOS, Android

tcp:ttl:32.comment: Initial TTL 32 — very old Windows 3.x/9x or embedded

tcp:wscale:8.comment: TCP window scale 8 (256x) — Windows 10/11, some Android

tcp:wscale:5.comment: TCP window scale 5 (32x) — older Windows, some embedded

tcp:wscale:10.comment: TCP window scale 10 (1024x) — newer Linux kernels with BDP tuning

tcp:wscale:3.comment: TCP window scale 3 (8x) — iOS / older mobile stacks

tcp:opts:2_4_8_1_3.comment: TCP opts [MSS, SACK-OK, TS, NOP, WScale] — Linux standard order

tcp:opts:2_1_3_1_1_4.comment: TCP opts [MSS, NOP, WScale, NOP, NOP, SACK-OK] — Windows standard order

tcp:opts:2_1_3_1_1_8_4.comment: TCP opts [MSS, NOP, WScale, NOP, NOP, TS, SACK-OK] — macOS standard order

tcp:opts:2_4_5_1_3.comment: TCP opts [MSS, SACK-OK, TS-alt, NOP, WScale] — FreeBSD / OpenBSD variant

tcp:ts:present.comment: TCP timestamps enabled — Linux, macOS, BSD (Windows disables by default)

tcp:ts:absent.comment: TCP timestamps absent — Windows default, mobile stacks

tcp:window:64240.comment: TCP window 64240 — Linux kernel 5.x+ default and Windows 10/11 with autotuning

tcp:window:65535.comment: TCP window 65535 — macOS, iOS, FreeBSD, some Windows

tcp:window:16384.comment: TCP window 16384 — OpenBSD default, some Cisco

tcp:mss:1460.comment: TCP MSS 1460 — standard Ethernet (low discriminating power, many OSes)

ssh:kex:curve25519.comment: KEX curve25519-sha256 — OpenSSH 6.5+ (Ubuntu 14.04+, Debian 8+, macOS 10.13+, FreeBSD 10+)

ssh:kex:gss.comment: KEX gss-* — Kerberos, Windows Active Directory SSH environments

ssh:hostkey:ed25519.comment: Host key ed25519 — OpenSSH 6.5+; default on modern Linux/BSD

ssh:hostkey:ecdsa_sha2_nistp256.comment: Host key ecdsa-p256 — common on RHEL/CentOS and macOS

ssh:hostkey:ecdsa_sha2_nistp384.comment: Host key ecdsa-p384 — less common, FIPS-mode RHEL/Fedora

ssh:hostkey:rsa.comment: Host key ssh-rsa — universal; low discriminating power

ssh:hostkey:rsa_sha2_256.comment: Host key rsa-sha2-256 — OpenSSH 8.x+ server-sig-alg negotiation

ssh:hostkey:dss.comment: Host key ssh-dss — deprecated DSA; only old / unpatched systems

ssh:cipher:chacha20_poly1305.comment: Cipher chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com — OpenSSH 6.5+ default on Linux/macOS

ssh:cipher:aes256_ctr.comment: Cipher aes256-ctr — universal, prominent on servers/RHEL/CentOS

ssh:cipher:3des_cbc.comment: Cipher 3des-cbc — legacy; common on old Windows SSH or unpatched systems

dhcp:vendor:android_dhcp.comment: DHCP vendor class android-dhcp-* — Android devices

dhcp:vendor:udhcp.comment: DHCP vendor class udhcp/udhcpd — embedded Linux (OpenWRT, BusyBox)

tcp:opts:2_1_1_4_1_3.comment: TCP opts [MSS, NOP, NOP, SACK-OK, NOP, WScale] — Linux alternative opts ordering

tcp:window:8760.comment: TCP window 8760 — Windows XP/2003 default initial window

tcp:window:5840.comment: TCP window 5840 — Linux kernel 2.x default initial window

ssh:kex:dh_group14.comment: DH group 14 (2048-bit) — preferred on RHEL/CentOS; also Windows OpenSSH

ssh:kex:dh_group1.comment: DH group 1 (1024-bit, legacy) — old OpenSSH/Cisco; deprecated in modern systems
